Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Built for MAX-TAC, this helmet contains the most robust optical suite ever packed into headgear. A fully kitted-out model can locate and track threats in any environment, while its nano-alloy easily resists small arms fire without over-encumbering its user. To put it simply, the Max-Helm’s capabilities are as insane as its users are.

SP 16 Head Armor with an Armor Penalty of -1 to REF, and -2 to DEX and MOVE. All ablation this armor would suffer is reduced by 1 (Minimum 0). This armor’s SP is not halved by Martial Arts Attacks and Special Moves. Has built-in Smart Ears (w/ Level Damper and Radio Communicator) and modified Smart Glasses with 8 Option Slots for Cybereye Options. This armor is also capable of installing Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancements. This armor repairs itself for 1 point of lost SP at the end of each day in which it does not lose SP.

Covers: Head
SP: 16
Armor Penalty: -1 REF, -2 DEX, -2 MOVE

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's penalty is -1 REF, -2 DEX, -2 MOVE. The sheet applies one penalty to all three stats, so it uses -2; add the difference back by hand for the lighter stat(s).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
